narrative.details: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.objectives: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
